dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: Come, children, it's time to offer up your prayers to the Moon Goddess...

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: I am a servant to the Frost Moon and bearer of the High Priestess's mantle beneath the silver gaze. In this sublunary sphere, I am known as Sarakka, sister to the previous Moonchanter.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: If you, too, wish to pray before Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar, you are always welcome to join us.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: Indeed, traveler. We are praying to the benevolent Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: She has given us the knowledge and power to survive in this dark land. Everything we have is born of her generosity.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: The children must learn that no matter what hardships we face, Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar always listens to our hymns. So long as our hearts are devout, she will answer our prayers.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: Indeed, traveler. We are praying to the benevolent Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: Lauma surely has her reasons for the decisions she makes — faith is no object to be bartered. Yet praying to the Moon Goddess is our tradition, and traditions should not easily be discarded.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: The children must learn that even though Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar may not answer each prayer directly, they must keep their hearts as clear and unblemished as moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shan't disturb you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Sarakka
dialogues.text: Go, traveler, and may the gentle light of Lady Kuu{RUBY#[S]Moon Maiden}tar ever illuminate your heart.
